reason: The simulation is functionally complete and verified, but it still fails the sandbox due to stdout contamination and has two minor logic/implementation issues that impact metric fidelity. With three iterations remaining, we can feasibly fix the stdout JSON-only requirement, align adoption/compliance timing, clean up vendor stock accounting, and ensure frozen-parameter validation during calibration. These changes should bring the project to acceptance and improve reliability without major redesign.

specific_areas: Enforce stdout discipline: only print the final JSON; route all other logs/warnings/visualizations to stderr or files
Fix AdoptionAggregator to use current-day wear_flags buffer (remove one-day lag)
Remove redundant vendor.stock decrements in commit; rely on buffered end-of-day inventory
Ensure parameter_definitions.json is accessible during calibration (copy into calibration_runs or pass path)
Add an automated test that asserts stdout contains exactly one JSON object and no other text
Replace print calls in adapters/calibrators with stderr/logging

task_understanding.adjustments: Prioritize sandbox acceptance criteria: stdout must contain exactly one JSON object; treat any other stdout as a blocking error.

data_analysis.adjustments: No new external data planned for the next iteration; maintain current placeholders.

model_planning.adjustments: Plan targeted fixes only: adoption/compliance timing via wear_flags, inventory commit simplification, parameter definitions availability during calibration.

code_generation.adjustments: Refactor output calls to use stderr or logging; remove/guard sim.visualize() from main; implement the AdoptionAggregator and commit changes; add file copy for parameter_definitions.json in calibration runs.

code_verification.adjustments: Add CI check to execute main and assert stdout is a single valid JSON line; add unit test for AdoptionAggregator with and without wear_flags buffer; lint for stray print calls to stdout.

simulation_execution.adjustments: Introduce or enable a quiet mode defaulting to no stdout logs; ensure artifacts directory is used for logs/plots; seed handling remains deterministic.

result_evaluation.adjustments: Ensure evaluators/adapters do not print to stdout; if needed, write diagnostics to artifacts; keep final results summarized in the single JSON output.

feedback_generation.adjustments: Emphasize blocking issues first (stdout JSON-only), then list minor logic fixes and confirm with tests; provide clear pass/fail gates for the next iteration.
